description: Americano coffee is a simple yet bold drink made by combining hot water with a shot of espresso. Known for its smooth and diluted flavor compared to straight espresso, it''s a popular choice for those who enjoy a milder caffeine kick without losing the rich aroma.

description: Fries, also known as French fries, are crispy and golden strips of potato, usually deep-fried to perfection.
